_comment: Cross-port REST collection segments. For each case, `segment` is the REST collection segment the object is served under, given its name, the @collectionName it declares (`collectionName`, absent when none) and the project's `naming.collections` (`pluralizer`, absent when none). With neither, the segment is the rule every port has always served: snake_case the name, then pluralize. A declared name, or a configured pluralizer's output over the name, is snake_cased with an acronym-aware split: a trailing plural `s`/`es` after a capital is a suffix, not a word (`FAQs` -> `faqs`, not `fa_qs`). Run by TypeScript (metadata/test/naming.test.ts) and C# (MetaObjects.Codegen.Tests/CollectionSegmentTests.cs), the two ports whose generators read @collectionName and naming.collections (#549).
